_comment: Maps every point of TODO-tests-linux.md « To confirm on Linux » to the Linux field report evidence that decides it. Each unchecked TODO line carries <!-- field-point: <id> --> on its first line. A check names a step of diagnostics/data/field_run_steps.json (the daemon's field run) or of diagnostics/data/field_guided_steps.json (the collector's probe and guided steps, tools/dev/field-guided.py), optionally the report steps that decide it. A point with no check states why a field report cannot test it (not_testable). tools/dev/field-todo-summary.py --os linux gives one verdict per point (docs/tooling/linux-field-report-coverage.md); tests/unit/diagnostics/engine/control/test_field_todo_coverage.lua fails when a TODO line has no entry or an entry names a missing step.

points.title: Raw telemetry rows (window topology, network, WireGuard)
points.condition: An X11 session with Metrics on; a second monitor and a WireGuard tunnel for the matching steps (each can be skipped by name).

points.title: Wayland focus on GNOME and KDE
points.condition: A GNOME Shell 45+ or Plasma Wayland session after install.sh (and a new login on GNOME).
points.not_testable: GNOME, Plasma 6 and Plasma 5 are separate sessions: one report proves the session it runs in; run it once per desktop.

points.title: Physical acceptance (grabs, polkit, autostart, wizard, magic key, hotplug)
points.condition: A real desktop on a kernel with uinput and evdev.
points.not_testable: Wayland and X11 are separate sessions, and real kernel capture with ordered pairs (93) needs Xorg or a compositor reading the daemon's virtual keyboard: run the report once per session type.

points.title: Item 50 cascade and the composed layout on a physical keyboard
Reading font and spacing reach the open windows at once, and the setup wizard offers them
Layout emulation W1 to W4 on KDE
points.condition: A KDE Plasma Wayland session with the Bépo registry layout.

points.title: Owned GTK host dialogs
Physical shortcut delivery (LIN-004)
points.condition: A real keyboard under the evdev grab (decided by the maintainer on 2026-11-11: the getter answers true).

points.title: Predictions stop on activity
points.condition: A slow local model; a mouse, a wheel and a touchpad.

points.title: Reading font: windows follow, the tray keeps the theme
points.not_testable: The report reads the row in Configuration; that the open windows follow the font while the tray keeps the theme is seen on screen.

points.title: Tray « Suspendre » row before Reload
points.not_testable: That a hotstring stays unexpanded while paused is typed by a person: the report clicks the row over D-Bus and proves its place, its tick and the paused header, not the typing.

points.title: Configuration titles
Débogage logs rows and the detailed log switch
points.not_testable: The report reads the rows and the « Journal détaillé » tick but never clicks it (it writes config.toml): ticking it and the « Signaler un bug » warning line stay a person's check.

points.title: Tray shortcut hints beside Suspend, Reload and Quit
points.not_testable: The report reads the preset chords' labels and the paused tick; moving or clearing a chord and switching the chords off change the user's settings, and how GNOME, KDE and COSMIC draw the longer rows is seen on screen.

points.title: The AI menu's local server rows commit while paused; only the rescan waits
points.not_testable: Needs a local server (LM Studio or oMLX) running and a person choosing a model, an address and a key while paused, then asking for a rescan: the field report does not drive the model selector page.

points.title: Managed Ollama cold start to readiness on a quiet desktop (OLL-06)
points.not_testable: Needs a quiet desktop timed twice, after a new login and right after the runtime's first install: the field report runs inside a busy session and does not install the runtime.

points.title: Owned Ollama archive download timed on a first real install
points.not_testable: Needs a first install of the 1.4 GB managed Ollama runtime over the real network, timed by a person: the field report does not install the runtime.

points.title: Pasted text kept out of clipboard managers (x-kde-passwordManagerHint)
points.not_testable: The report counts the clipboard restores lost since the start; reading Klipper's, GPaste's or CopyQ's history after a paste is a person's check.

points.title: Tray without a tray host: the window and notification that say so, then its click and its accessible name (TRAY-03)
points.not_testable: Needs a GNOME session without the AppIndicator extension, then a panel with one, and a screen reader: the field report runs inside the user's own session and cannot remove or add a panel extension.

points.title: Numeric prompt, action picker title-bar close and open_app refusal (PCK-03, PCK-04, PCK-06, PCK-09)
points.not_testable: Needs a person at the desktop with Orca, typing in the numeric prompt, closing the picker from its title bar and choosing a file in the open_app dialog: the field report opens no window.

points.title: Updates and download windows: Escape, Orca, a cancelled and a closed update download (UPD-02 to UPD-05)
points.not_testable: Needs a standalone install offered a newer release, a person who cancels and then closes the download window, and Orca: the field report never downloads or installs an update.

points.title: Layout manager and Studio: Orca language, focus after Install, Escape (LTP-02, LTP-06, LTP-07)
points.not_testable: Needs a person with Orca in the layout manager and Ergopti Studio, in a locale other than French: the field report neither listens to Orca nor installs a layout.

points.title: Metrics dashboards: a failed range read, the range status read by Orca, numbers in the interface language and the apps incomplete notice (MET-04 to MET-07)
points.not_testable: Needs a person with Orca at the dashboards and a metrics store made unreadable then restored: the field report neither listens to a screen reader nor damages the metrics store.

points.title: Screen-reader switch of the previews: a preview and a finished prediction said by Orca, silent when unticked
points.not_testable: Needs a person listening to Orca while previews and predictions draw: the field report neither listens to a screen reader nor types hotstrings into a focused window.

points.title: Missing tray logo: the warning sign, its Orca name and one logged error (TRAY-05)
points.not_testable: Needs a copy of the install with a logo file moved away, a panel and a screen reader: the field report must not damage the installed daemon and reads no screen reader.

points.title: Branch wave3/input-policies: sticky delay, CapsWord menu, one-shot Shift device
Layout editor in its own window
points.not_testable: Opening, refocusing and closing a WebKitGTK window needs a person at the desktop: open « Create or edit a layout… » and the manager's « Layout editor », check one window comes back to the front with its unsaved work, then « Close ».

points.title: Direct XKB compiler: a sided-modifier layer on XKB's fifth level
points.condition: A repository checkout with Node and Lua 5.4 on a real desktop (X11 or Wayland).

points.title: One-shot modifiers: no time limit, sticky actions, AltGr tap-hold pair
points.condition: A real keyboard; a GTK and a Qt application.
points.not_testable: Which modifiers the application received after a `sticky_*` action is a person's reading of the typed result: the report proves only the sticky delay row.

points.title: Native carriage of `shortcut_key`: XKB omission and emulation
points.not_testable: Whether the emulated shortcut reaches a real application as the shortcut key is a person's reading of the focused application: no field run step drives an exported source.

points.title: Incremental touchpad swipes on a real touchpad
points.not_testable: Whether one action fires per step of real finger travel is a person's reading of the swipe against the result: the container kernel has no evdev touchpad and no log line measures the travel felt.

points.title: Typing-speed widget bursts (TWD-2)
points.not_testable: The widget is read on screen: when it shows and hides as each key, modifier tap and pointer move arrives; the rule itself is unit-tested on the three drivers (twd2-typing-burst, twd2-level-modifiers, twd2-pointer-hides, twd2-keymap-role).

points.title: Eject a real removable disk through udisks and polkit
points.not_testable: No field run or guided step drives eject_all_disks yet: a person plugs and mounts a USB stick, fires the bound gesture and checks the stick left lsblk and the file manager while the system disks stayed mounted.

points.title: Install, use and remove a registry layout on an X11 session
points.not_testable: No field run or guided step installs a layout yet: a person on a GNOME or Plasma X11 session installs Ergo-L from the menu and from Studio, types with it, checks xkbcomp names ergol after a keyboard plug, then uninstalls it from the user XKB tree.

points.title: Live layout switch on KDE Plasma through the keyboard daemon
points.not_testable: The report proves the active layout is resolved and named and that the KDE watch follows switches; picking the other layout in « Input sources » and typing after it is a person's check (the report never switches the user's layout).

points.title: AI agent calendar, reminder and mail connectors in real desktop applications
points.not_testable: No field run or guided step accepts an agent action yet: a person with a configured AI accepts a calendar event, a reminder and a mail and checks the calendar import and the unsent draft in their own applications.

points.title: One folder name: the legacy folders migrated on the maintainer's Linux machine
points.not_testable: The migration runs once on the maintainer's own legacy folders, which a field run cannot recreate without touching the real profile: a person checks the folders listed in the handoff.

points.title: Accessibility with Orca: the tray menu, the GTK dialogs, the WebKit windows and the overlays
points.not_testable: A field run reads no screen reader: a person runs Orca on GNOME and KDE and checks what it reads in the tray menu, the dialogs and the WebKit windows, and what it says when a preview appears.

points.title: Backspace restore: a Backspace right after an expansion gives the trigger back
points.not_testable: A field run types no hotstring and times no Backspace against the undo window: a person expands a magic-key trigger and a Space-terminated one in a real editor and checks the text each Backspace leaves.

points.title: Daily note refusals logged and the Windows-only note settings’ reason (SNU-08, SNU-09)
points.not_testable: Needs a notes folder made read-only and a broken text/plain handler on the person’s desktop: the field report changes neither the data folder nor the desktop associations.

points.title: Software centres and menus show the package metadata
points.not_testable: Needs a person to install the release packages and read the software centre's page: the field report runs from a checkout and installs no package; tools/test/test-app-metadata.cjs pins the fields every packager writes.

points.title: Report a bug and Suggest a feature open GitHub forms with readable, complete facts (2026-11-24)
points.not_testable: Needs a person signed in to GitHub in a browser to look at the opened forms and paste the clipboard: the field report opens no browser and reads no web page.

points.title: Field report progress window (2026-11-24)
points.not_testable: The window is the person's: Debug > « Lancer le field report (tous les tests) » opened, then its Stop, its close box and its end buttons clicked, and the issue form looked at in a browser. The page, the observer's messages and each action are unit-tested (test_field_report, test_healthcheck_report_issue, field-report-window.playwright.cjs).

points.title: GNOME 50 and 51 focus extension (fixed 2026-11-25)
points.condition: A GNOME 50 or 51 Wayland session after install.sh and a new login (Fedora 44 or Ubuntu 26.04).
points.not_testable: The extension's ACTIVE state and GNOME's input source after a tray switch are read by the person in gnome-extensions and the shell; the report proves the focus reports the extension sends.

points.title: Clipboard on GNOME Wayland (2026-11-25)
points.not_testable: Needs a real GNOME 50 Wayland desktop with a focused text field, the desktop and a fullscreen video, and a person watching for a flashing window and checking the restored clipboard: no run types into another application's field.

points.title: Startup without graphical-session.target (fixed 2026-11-25)
points.not_testable: Needs Xfce, Cinnamon, Openbox, i3 and sway sessions, each with install.sh run from it and a logout and login: one report runs in one already started session and installs nothing.

points.title: Bounded restarts (fixed 2026-11-25)
points.not_testable: Needs the .deb installed, uinput unloaded and blacklisted with sudo, and a new login: the field report runs from a checkout with a working /dev/uinput and never changes kernel modules.

points.title: The .rpm on openSUSE (fixed 2026-11-25)
points.not_testable: Needs a person to install the release .rpm with zypper on Tumbleweed and Leap 15.6 and to install the GNOME AppIndicator extension: the field report runs from a checkout and installs no package.

points.title: Tray ticks survive a KDE hover and single choices are radios (fixed 2026-11-25)
Red component-problem rows in the tray (2026-11-25)
The touchpad stays enabled: the virtual keyboard is no mouse (fixed 2026-11-25)
points.condition: A laptop with a touchpad; the virtual pointer exists only while a wheel binding of the navigation layer is held.

points.title: Session health after the fixes of 2026-11-25
